The relationship between imagery abilities
and trauma outcome was assessed using a linear
regression with object (OSIQ Object [OSIQ-O] subscale)
and spatial imagery (OSIQ Spatial [OSIQ-S] subscale) as
mean-centered predictors and PTSD symptoms (IES-R) as
the outcome. We controlled for depression symptoms
(PHQ-9; mean-centered) and gender because of their
well-known associations with both imagery (Holmes et al.,
2016; Ji et al., 2019) and PTSD symptoms (Olff et al.,
2007). We included interaction terms with gender to assess
the degree to which gender moderates the relationship
between imagery and PTSD symptoms (n = 792 because
14 participants declined to indicate gender).
